name: kmr232ngulclfs
description: C&K KMR232NGULCLFS low-current SPST-NO tactile switch
watch_out_for: Manufacturer KMR2 NG recommended land: 5 mm width, 3.2 mm inner gap, 2.6 mm height, 0.6 mm vertical gap. Manufacturer terminals 4/1 share logical 1; 3/2 share logical 2. ULC minimum 1 uA at 1.8 V; maximum 50 mA, 32 V and 1 VA, silver long-life 3 N version. No ground terminal. Supplier-associated nominal 223JMVXX body is a geometric equivalent, not manufacturer-certified CAD; STEP representation origin normalized from +1.42 to 0 mm Z to match its WRL seating plane. 3D source: JLCEDA/EasyEDA Official Library, https://lceda.cn/ and https://easyeda.com/, product C221681.
